---
title: "Shell ↔ R Cheat Sheet"
---

One page mapping every shell command in this book to its R equivalent. Keep it beside your terminal.

| Shell | R equivalent |
|:------|:-------------|
| `pwd` | `getwd()` / `here::here()` |
| `ls` | `dir()` / `list.files()` / `fs::dir_ls()` |
| `ls -la` | `fs::dir_info()` |
| `cd dir` | `setwd("dir")` |
| `mkdir dir` | `dir.create("dir")` / `fs::dir_create()` |
| `rmdir dir` | `fs::dir_delete()` |
| `touch file` | `file.create()` / `fs::file_touch()` |
| `cp a b` | `file.copy()` / `fs::file_copy()` |
| `mv a b` | `file.rename()` / `fs::file_move()` |
| `rm file` | `file.remove()` / `fs::file_delete()` |
| `echo text` | `cat()` / `message()` |
| `cat file` | `readLines()` |
| `head -n 5 file` | `head(readLines("file"), 5)` |
| `tail -n 5 file` | `tail(readLines("file"), 5)` |
| `wc -l file` | `length(readLines("file"))` |
| `sort file` | `sort()` |
| `sort -u file` | `unique(sort())` |
| `grep pattern file` | `grep()` / `stringr::str_detect()` |
| `find dir -name '*.txt'` | `list.files(dir, pattern = "\\.txt$")` |
| `wget URL` / `curl -O URL` | `download.file()` / `curl::curl_download()` |
| `tar -xvf f.tar` | `utils::untar()` |
| `zip -r z.zip dir` | `zip::zip()` |
| `unzip f.zip` | `zip::unzip()` |
| `gzip -dc f.gz` | `gzcon()` / `readr::read_csv()` |
| `sleep 5` | `Sys.sleep(5)` |
| `history` | `history()` |
| `diff a b` | `waldo::compare()` / `diffobj::diffObj()` |
| `system2("ls")` | run shell from R |
| `Rscript script.R` | run R from shell |
